The mock bill is a Huntington auto loan. Customer Service FAQ: from another Huntington account use My Accounts - Overview and Pay Now; from an account at another bank use Transfers - Transfer Funds and Make a Payment From an Account at Another Bank; or log in to Huntington.com/the app, select the auto loan and choose make a payment; mail to Huntington Installment Loans, P.O. Box 182519, Columbus, OH 43218; or use huntington.com/payment, which opens the Speedpay (ACI Worldwide) guest page for Huntington National Bank: account number + ZIP code, checking account only (the form was only viewed, never submitted; any Speedpay fee is not published there, so none is modelled). Questions: 1-800-480-BANK (2265). Auto loan AutoPay, paperless and hardship options are not described on these public pages, so they stay at the family defaults (Bill Pay recurring payments on the FAQ are for third-party payees). help.title: How do I make an auto loan payment?
paragraphs: Log in at Huntington.com or in the Huntington mobile app, select your auto loan and choose make a payment. To pay from another Huntington account, go to My Accounts - Overview and select Pay Now next to the loan. To pay from an account at another bank, go to Transfers - Transfer Funds and choose Make a Payment From an Account at Another Bank.
Without logging in, use Make a Payment: enter your loan account number and ZIP code and pay from a checking account.
By mail, send your payment to Huntington Installment Loans, P.O. Box 182519, Columbus, OH 43218. You can also pay at a Huntington branch.

help.title: Contact Huntington
paragraphs: Call 1-800-480-BANK (2265) with questions about your loan or accounts, or visit your local Huntington branch.
